{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Neat cotton blouse, tailored, knee-length, white #FFFFFF, soft woven cotton  
Black slim-fit trousers, straight leg, full length, black #000000, stretchy knit  
White leather open-toe slingback sandals with block heel and ankle strap, medium height, white #FFFFFF, smooth leather  

This outfit works because the crisp white blouse paired with sleek black trousers creates a modern, balanced look perfect for an intimate birthday celebration. The white sandals echo the top while grounding the ensemble in sophistication without overdoing it. Ideal for autumn evening warmth or air-conditioned venues, the clean lines and neutral tones let your personality shine through.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-ф1", "name": "White leather open-toe slingback sandals with block heel and ankle strap"}]}
